description: Example test prompts for benchmarking cicada MCP tool call frequency

tests.name: Simple Module Search
tests.prompt: What functions are available in the Cicada.Formatter module?

tests.name: Function Definition Lookup
tests.prompt: Show me the definition of the load_index function

tests.name: Module List Query
tests.prompt: List all modules in the cicada package

tests.name: Function Call Sites
tests.prompt: Where is the load_index function called in the codebase?

tests.name: Module Dependencies
tests.prompt: Show me all files that import or use the Cicada.GitHelper module

tests.name: Function Usage Examples
tests.prompt: Give me examples of how search_module is used with code snippets

git_attribution.description: Git history and PR attribution queries

tests.name: Line Attribution
tests.prompt: Which PR introduced line 50 in cicada/mcp_server.py?

tests.name: File PR History
tests.prompt: Show me all PRs that modified the indexer.py file

tests.name: Function History
tests.prompt: What is the commit history of the load_index function?

tests.name: Code Authorship
tests.prompt: Who wrote the code between lines 100-150 in mcp_server.py?

complex_multi_tool.description: Complex queries requiring multiple tool invocations

tests.name: Module Analysis with History
tests.prompt: Analyze the Cicada.Formatter module - show all functions, where they're used, and who created them

tests.name: Function Refactoring Analysis
tests.prompt: I want to refactor the search_function tool. Show me its definition, all call sites, and any PRs that discussed it

tests.name: Feature Investigation
tests.prompt: Find all code related to PR indexing, show module structure, and explain when it was added

tests.name: Dead Code Detection
tests.prompt: Find unused functions in the codebase and tell me who wrote them

tests.name: Concept Search
tests.prompt: Find all code related to authentication and user management

tests.name: Wildcard Pattern Search
tests.prompt: Find all functions that start with 'create_' or 'build_'

tests.name: Topic Discovery
tests.prompt: Show me all modules and functions related to git operations

tests.name: Dead Code Analysis
tests.prompt: Find potentially unused functions in the codebase

tests.name: High Confidence Dead Code
tests.prompt: Show me functions that are definitely not used anywhere

tests.name: Module Health Check
tests.prompt: Analyze the mcp_server.py module for unused exports

tests.name: Bug Investigation
tests.prompt: The search_module function is returning incorrect results. Show me its implementation, recent changes, and test usage

tests.name: Code Review Context
tests.prompt: I'm reviewing a PR that changes the indexer. Show me what the indexer module does, how it's used, and its history

tests.name: Onboarding Question
tests.prompt: I'm new to the codebase. Explain what the cicada MCP server does and show me the main entry points

tests.name: Breaking Change Impact
tests.prompt: If I change the signature of load_index, what will break? Show me all callers and their context

tests.name: Feature Origin
tests.prompt: When was keyword search added? Show me the PR that introduced it and the implementation

stress_tests.description: High complexity queries to stress test tool usage

tests.name: Complete Module Audit
tests.prompt: Give me a complete audit of the mcp_server.py file: all functions, their usage, git history, authors, PRs, and any dead code

tests.name: Cross-Module Analysis
tests.prompt: Analyze the relationship between the indexer, parser, and formatter modules. Show dependencies, shared functions, and evolution over time

tests.name: Full Stack Trace
tests.prompt: Trace the execution flow from when a user runs 'cicada' command to the indexer completing. Show all modules and functions involved

model_comparison.description: Test with different models to compare tool usage

notes.expected_tools: List of tools expected to be used for each test (not enforced, just for reference)
notes.prompt_engineering: Prompts are designed to naturally trigger cicada tool usage
notes.customization: Feel free to add your own test cases or modify existing ones
